Hi Diego,

Thanks for the benchmark you published — I downloaded the report (attached) and it surfaced a few questions for our infra team. Would love a short demo to see the runtime characteristics and cost/latency recommendations for models similar to ours.

We're a small ML infra team at BrightGrid evaluating options for moving inference off our in-house cluster. A 30-minute session to cover: what the runtime looks like, latency expectations for 8k/16k tokens, and pricing would be ideal.

A few times that work on our side (PST):
- Tue Nov 10, 10:00–10:30 
- Wed Nov 11, 13:00–13:30

Attaching a short PDF with our benchmark notes: brightgrid-benchmark-notes.pdf (2 pages).

If those slots don't work I can be flexible — copying Alexis (ops) who will join.

Thanks,
Simon Lee
Head of ML Infrastructure
BrightGrid
